subject: Post-demo recap — buying roles, procurement/security contacts, scope clarification
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurabanking.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T09:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo recap — buying roles, procurement/security contacts, scope clarification

Hi Liam — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from call:
- Redwood demo: hosted + private options, typical trade-offs (latency vs data isolation).
- Primary use case: customer-facing fraud scoring API + periodic batch embeddings for search.
- Early KPIs: p99 latency < 250ms for API, monthly inference cost target under internal benchmark.

Asks / open items we need from your side to start the security intake: 
1) Economic buyer / procurement owner (name + best email) — we need to route commercial approvals and contract questions.
2) Security owner who will lead the questionnaire (SOC2 evidence, infra boundary, data flows).
3) Confirmation of systems in scope (brief list) — from our notes: public API, internal admin portal, S3 data lake; please confirm or add.
4) Any existing procurement cadence (PO, contract template, T&Cs) and required contract lead time.

Attachments: I attached our security questionnaire (lightweight v2) — filling the highlighted tabs will let our security team determine if we can proceed with a self-serve onboarding or if we need a scoped Private deployment.

[Attachment: security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx]

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Please share contacts for procurement + security by EOD Wed (2026-12-10).
- Once we have the security owner, we’ll schedule a 45-min security kickoff (scope + evidence map).
- Ben (CC) will draft a short mutual action plan in HubSpot and propose commercial milestones.

Proposed kickoff slots (your timezone): Thu 2026-12-11 10:00–10:45 / Fri 2026-12-12 14:00–14:45. Let us know what works and who should join (network, app owners, procurement).

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[aisha.rahman@redwood.com]
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@aurabanking.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — buying roles, procurement/security contacts, scope clarification

Thanks Aisha — great session. A few quick answers below and a doc link to our network diagram for context.

Economic buyer / procurement:
- Procurement lead: procurement@aurabanking.com (managed by Elena Ruiz, she handles PO and T&C triage).
- Commercial decision maker: Liam O'Connor (me) — I’ll be the final sign-off on budget but Elena will run legal/procurement gate.

Security owner / contacts:
- Security lead: Nina Shah <nina.shah@aurabanking.com> — she owns vendor security assessments and SOC2 evidence collection.
- App owner: Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv.m@aurabanking.com> (internal) for the fraud API.

Systems in scope (confirming and adding details):
- Customer-facing fraud scoring API (production cluster) — in scope.
- Internal admin portal (used by ops) — in scope.
- Data lake (S3) containing training and scoring datasets — in scope for data residency checks.
- Batch processing cluster (Airflow) — likely out of scope for initial review, but we can include if needed.

Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abcd1234-network-diagram (network diagram, redacted)

We can do the security kickoff on Thu 2026-12-11 at 10:00 — I’ll ask Nina and Elena to join. If you need any pre-populated answers for the questionnaire, tell me which tabs you want prioritized.

-Liam

Date: 2026-12-09T11:36:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap — buying roles, procurement/security contacts, scope clarification

Thanks Liam — that helps a lot. I’ve created a short mutual action plan in HubSpot (link below) and captured the commercial milestones that will drive the timeline. High-level notes for the team: 

Decision criteria (as discussed):
- Performance: p99 latency target and throughput SLAs for peak windows.
- Data controls: ability to pin model versions, VPC/private deployment option, and KMS integration.
- Cost: forecasted monthly inference spend with an option to move to Dedicated if predictable.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 evidence + network isolation for production PII flows.

Two clarifying Qs for scope: 
1) Will AuraBanking upload customer data to Redwood-hosted S3 or will you provide a proxied connector from your VPC? The security implications are different and will affect the checklist.
2) Can Nina confirm whether we need encryption-at-rest certificates or if you manage keys via your KMS?

Tentative timelines:
- Questionnaire returned (partial answers) — target 5 business days after kickoff (2026-12-18).
- Security kickoff meeting (scheduled Thu 2026-12-11 10:00) — agenda: systems boundary, evidence owner mapping, docs & next steps.
- Commercial draft to Elena for PO/T&C review — target week of 2026-12-14.

HubSpot link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DEAL-2026-0157

[Attachment: security_questionnaire_v2.xlsx] (we’ll accept partial answers; highlight the required fields).

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — adding Nina and Elena to loop officially. 

Next actions before kickoff:
- Nina: if you can confirm whether AuraBanking will provide a VPC connector or upload to our hosted bucket, that will define which evidence fields we prioritize.
- Elena / procurement: we’ll send a short SOW + pricing draft after the kickoff; Ben will add PO requirements to the HubSpot deal.
- Rajiv / app owner: please be prepared to show the API endpoint patterns and any internal auth flow during the kickoff (20 minutes).

Security kickoff: Thu 2026-12-11 10:00–10:45 (Zoom link below). Please add any additional stakeholders.
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9999999999?pwd=securekickoff

Immediate deliverables from Redwood:
- We will send a pre-filled version of the questionnaire with common answers for infrastructure and our SOC2 artifacts.
- Ben will attach a concise data flow template to help map PII fields (we’ll upload to the Drive link above).

If Nina can paste a one-line confirmation on the VPC vs upload approach here, we’ll prioritize the right evidence set and keep the kickoff efficient.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwood.com
